summary: Western Copper & Gold Corp filed a Form 6-K furnishing a July 20, 2026 corporate update. The release reports Mitsubishi Materials completed open-market purchases of 1.2 million common shares, restoring its stake to ~5%, and satisfying conditions for an amended investor rights agreement. It also updates on YESAB regulatory submissions and a federal priority designation for a grid project. No transaction, buyback, or strategic review is announced; this is a routine operational update, so it does not qualify as a special situation.
